clips.title: The story
paras: On Fray Island, warriors face a trial before Klannoc Macleod will train them. The Affray pits them against island challengers and their champion.

Fray Island lies apart from the mainland, drawing brawlers, outcasts, and combat instructors. Klannoc Macleod does not teach every wanderer who arrives by boat. Aspiring warriors must first enter the Affray, where stamina and awareness in battle prove who can fight beyond mere boasting.

A warrior begins the Affray by stepping onto the central iron grate among the spectators. Ringmaster Twiggy Flathead then sends challengers into the ring one after another. Those who survive face the island's heavyweight champion, Big Will. Defeating him is the only way to earn Klannoc's respect.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray. It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.
To begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate. That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.
Beat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will. Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You have passed The Affray!
You are a worthy warrior, and I am honored to teach you...
